name: What is the typical process for a mobile home repair project?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for a mobile home repair project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The typical process begins with an initial consultation and inspection to assess the damage and determine the scope of work. We then provide a detailed estimate. Upon approval, our team schedules the repair, obtains any necessary permits (if applicable), and proceeds with the work. We ensure thorough cleanup and a final inspection upon completion. Communication is maintained throughout the project.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves an inspection, detailed estimate, scheduling, potential permitting, repair work, cleanup, and final inspection.
